definitions.explanation: Refers to everyday, routine circumstances as opposed to special or extraordinary situations. Used both as a noun (normal times) and as an adverb (normally, usually).

examples.japanese: {平生|へいぜい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{穏|おだ}やか→穏やか：02353_odayaka⟧な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
{平生|へいぜい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{心|こころ}がけ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
{平生|へいぜい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{備|そな}えて→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧おけば、⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{慌|あわ}てなくて→慌てる：01874_awateru⟧⟦{済|す}む→済む：01950_sumu⟧。
examples.english: If you prepare in normal times, you won't panic during a disaster.

notes:
A somewhat literary or formal synonym for ⟦{普段|ふだん}→普段：00041_fudan⟧ (usually, normally). Emphasizes the contrast between ordinary circumstances and exceptional situations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {平生|へいぜい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{行|おこな}い→行う：01238_okonau⟧: everyday conduct
- {平生|へいぜい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{心|こころ}がけ: one's usual attitude/mindset
- {平生|へいぜい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: from ordinary times onward (implying habitual preparation)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{普段|ふだん}→普段：00041_fudan⟧: usually, normally — more common in everyday speech
- ⟦{日頃|ひごろ}→日頃：07284_higoro⟧: on a daily basis, ordinarily — similar formality level
- {平素|へいそ}: ordinarily — even more formal, used in business correspondence

REGISTER:
More literary and formal than ⟦{普段|ふだん}→普段：00041_fudan⟧. Common in essays, formal writing, and proverbs.
